ourPost.text:
🎙️ Your business can have a voice agent. In 20 minutes. No coding required.

I've been building and teaching AI voice agents for a while now — and if there's one platform I keep coming back to, it's ElevenLabs.

Here's why I recommend it to every single student in my courses:
✅ Ridiculously easy to start No technical background needed. I've seen complete beginners launch their first voice agent in under 20 minutes. Not a toy demo — an actual working agent.
✅ The most emotionally rich voices I've ever heard And I've tested them all. ElevenLabs voices don't just sound human — they feel human. That matters when your agent is the first impression your business makes.
✅ Both inbound AND outbound Customer support, lead qualification, appointment booking — one platform handles it all.
✅ Pricing that makes sense Starts at just $5/month. There's genuinely no barrier to getting started.

If you've been putting off voice AI because it seemed too complex or too expensive — that excuse is gone.
👇 Drop your industry in the comments and I'll tell you exactly how a voice agent could work for your business.

insights.finding: Top posts open with a concrete number or a claim in under 70 characters. Ours opens with a company announcement.
Highest engagement clusters at 90-140 words. Longer posts get truncated behind "see more" and lose the payoff.
Demo video in the first frame, not linked at the end. Posts leading with video out-engage link-outs roughly 3:1.
Builder-to-builder, not press-release. First person plural, specific latency numbers, no adjectives like revolutionary.

recommendations: Open on the latency number, not the product name.
Cut to 120 words and move the demo video to the top.
Drop to three hashtags; posts above five underperform in this vertical.
improvedPrompt: We shipped dark mode in our dashboard. Make a 40-second demo video that opens on the feature itself with no title card, and a LinkedIn post under 120 words that leads with a concrete before/after, written builder-to-builder. Three hashtags maximum.
